ownerSelection: Hot caches plus Cold data caches with query-condition cache off. The condition-on cold case remains in the source CSV and is not plotted.
xAxis: CPU cores: max_threads varies on one fixed 59-vCPU node. These are not six physical service resizes.
workload: Original D1 and D2; equal counts; 12 repeats per query, core point and case; fixed data without ongoing ingestion.
throughput: sum(uncompressed read_bytes) / sum(server elapsed_ns); decimal GB/s.
perCore: sum(uncompressed read_bytes) / sum(User + System CPU seconds); decimal MB/s/core, matching 11a.
CPUCapacityBand: sum(CPU seconds) / sum(server elapsed seconds) / selected N cores. Percentage relative to N-core budget, not measured utilization of a physically resized N-core service.
memoryBand: Arithmetic mean of per-query peaks; measured independently by cache case and core point. Memory capacity is the actual 236-GiB service.

cachePolicy.hot: Filesystem, page and distributed data caches plus query-condition caching enabled.
cachePolicy.cold: Filesystem, page and distributed data caches bypassed; query-condition caching explicitly off.
cachePolicy.resultCache: Normal disabled setting, verified no result-cache reads.

geometry: Monotone cubic geometry through measured values; slider, markers and readouts snap to six observations. No numerical smoothing, averaging across core points or extrapolation.
comparisonLimit: Static-data test on a newer version and larger node; separate from original Run 2 continuous ingestion and its Gaussian display smoothing. Hot and selected Cold cases came from separate sequential measurement blocks.
